title: Haal Sunaawan Aai Haan
body:
Tere Baad Kivein Pai Nibhdi Hai,
Tainu Haal Sunaawan Aayi Haan
Teri Qabr Ko Aakhri Waari Ajj
Gul Baba Laawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Pyo Hain Je Kar Maa Hondi,
Tainu Apne Zakhm Dikhaawan Haa
Tainu Zakhm Dikha Ta Na Sakdi,
Par Zakhm Dasaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Chalo Mendi Khair Hai Ae Baba,
Tendi Tehreer Te Hansde Han
Teri Qabr Ch Teri Sanad Wale
Tukde Dafnaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jihde Dar Te Baba Rukda Hain,
Othon Bha Da Sek Nahi Vinda
Oh Sek Hai Mendi Chadar Tain,
Tathir Dikhaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jadon Dar Aaya Main Ujri Te,
Mede Hathaan Te Mera Mohsin Hae
Ohnade Main Ton Pehle Saah Muk Gaye,
Ohnda Sog Manaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Hasnain De Paase Dekh Kar,
Eh Mainu Talwar Dikhaunde Han
Dithi Maqtal Gah Darbaar De Wich,
Tainu Tu Parachaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Hik Sanad Bia Bha Dar Wali,
Bia Zakhmi Paasa Te Rassiyan
Baba Teri Qabr Te Ummatiyan De
Ehsaan Ginnaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
Aakhe Kazim Zahra Jaandi Haan,
Mainu Qabr Di Ja Ethe Nahi Milni
Par Qabr Di Ja Tere Rozay Wich,
Baba Rakhwaawan Aayi Haan
<<DIVIDER>>
(Kazim Hussain Kazim)
author: Kazim Hussain Kazim
